title: Mission and Objective System (briefings, chains, medals, difficulty)
description:
Purpose: Manage mission selection, briefing delivery, objective chains (defend, escort, cleanse, disable, rescue, defeat boss), optional challenges, scoring, medals, and difficulty scaling. Provides APIs for other mechanics to post objective progress and to receive mission context.

Controls/UI:
- Interacts with consoles/portals (via use/interact prompts) to select missions.
- Shows in-world objective markers via ring_hud_ui_pack and on-wrist mission log page.

Params (params_json):
- missions (JSON array): definitions including id, scenes, objectives, optional challenges, difficulty tiers, rewards (XP, unlocks, cosmetics).
- medal_thresholds: time/score thresholds for bronze/silver/gold.

Behaviour:
1) At Command Hall/Launch Platform, populate mission list with holographic briefings; selecting a mission queues its scene(s) and objectives.
2) Objective engine:
   - Tracks current objective(s), supports branches and retries, emits events on progress updates, and advances chains.
3) Scoring and medals:
   - Updates scoreboard per mission rules; awards medals when thresholds are met (e.g., zero_g_flight_gauntlet times).
4) Difficulty scaling:
   - Adjusts AI behaviour profiles and spawn counts per selected tier.
5) Rewards:
   - On completion, grants XP/unlocks via Progression system and triggers Auto-save.

Components:
- Reads: player actions/events, scene triggers, AI hooks.
- Writes: CMissionState, CObjectiveTracker, CHUDMarkers, reward events.

Acceptance hooks:
- test_mission_selection_flow: selection via console loads mission upon confirmation and portal activation.
- test_zero_g_gauntlet_medal: awards medal and stores in progression.

Integration and depends_on:
- Exposes APIs consumed by portal_and_sector_travel (to begin transitions) and progression_and_unlocks.
- Persists mission states via save_persistence.

Assets/scenes:
- mission_console_starmap_hologram in command_hall; launch_platform_gate in launch_platform.

Suggested file split: mission_register.cpp, mission_db.cpp, objectives_runtime.cpp, medals_scoring.cpp, mission_ui.cpp.
